title: Nasdaq 100 set to shed over $1 trillion as tech selloff deepens; SpaceX slides
title_zh: 随着科技股抛售加剧，纳斯达克 100 指数将损失超过 1 万亿美元； SpaceX 幻灯片
summary: The Nasdaq 100 index was on pace to erase more than $1 trillion in market value on Tuesday as technology heavyweights and chip stocks tumbled, ‌while Elon Musk's SpaceX dropped below $2 trillion in market cap for the first ‌time since its U.S. debut.
summary_zh: 随着科技巨头和芯片股暴跌，纳斯达克 100 指数周二市值将蒸发逾 1 万亿美元，而埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX 市值自美国上市以来首次跌破 2 万亿美元。

summary: STORY: From SK Hynix taking a lead to Apple's reported price hikes, this is Tech Weekly.:: Tech WeeklySK Hynix overtook rival Samsung Electronics to become South Korea's most valuable listed company.Shares rose high enough to turn SK Hynix into the world's most valuable memory...

title: Oracle workforce shrinks by about 21,000 amid AI adoption
title_zh: 由于采用人工智能，甲骨文员工人数减少约 21,000 人
summary: STORY: Oracle's total workforce declined 13%, or about 21,000 employees, in its fiscal 2026.It's as the cloud computing giant continued restructuring its business...partly driven by the adoption of AI across its operations.The company had a total workforce of 141,000 as of May...
summary_zh: 故事：在 2026 财年，甲骨文的员工总数减少了 13%，即约 21,000 名员工。这是因为这家云计算巨头继续重组其业务……部分原因是在其业务中采用人工智能。截至 5 月份，该公司的员工总数为 141,000 人……

title: NatPower, Tesla reach deal on first phase of $5 billion battery storage plan
title_zh: NatPower与特斯拉就价值50亿美元的电池存储计划第一阶段达成协议
summary: LONDON, June 23 (Reuters) - Independent energy firm NatPower and ‌Tesla said on Tuesday they had reached ‌a deal to build 25 gigawatt hours of battery storage ​in Italy and Britain, the first phase of a project worth up to $5 billion.
summary_zh: 路透伦敦 6 月 23 日 - 独立能源公司 NatPower 和特斯拉周二表示，他们已达成协议，将在意大利和英国建设 25 吉瓦时的电池存储设施，这是该项目第一阶段价值高达 50 亿美元的项目。

title: Does Elon Musk represent a new form of capitalism?: podcast
title_zh: 埃隆·马斯克代表了一种新的资本主义形式吗？：播客
summary: LONDON, June 23 (Reuters Breakingviews) - Follow on Apple or Spotify. The SpaceX ​boss became the first trillionaire by defying business wisdom, upending financial standards and embracing far-right politics.
summary_zh: 伦敦，6 月 23 日（路透社 Breakingviews）——关注 Apple 或 Spotify。这位 SpaceX 老板通过藐视商业智慧、颠覆金融标准和拥抱极右政治，成为第一位万亿富翁。

title: Memory's price surge threatens Apple's 'magic formula' — and the economy: WSJ reporter
title_zh: 内存价格飙升威胁苹果的“神奇配方”和经济：《华尔街日报》记者
summary: Wall Street Journal technology reporter Rolfe Winkler discusses his interview with Apple (AAPL) CEO Tim Cook, who said that rising memory costs have made iPhone price increases "unavoidable."
summary_zh: 《华尔街日报》科技记者罗尔夫·温克勒 (Rolfe Winkler) 讨论了他对苹果 (AAPL) 首席执行官蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 的采访，库克表示，内存成本上涨使得 iPhone 价格上涨“不可避免”。

title: SpaceX initiates first bond sale while the stock sheds post-IPO gains
title_zh: SpaceX 启动首次债券发行，而该股则失去了 IPO 后的涨幅
summary: SpaceX (SPCX) stock has sunk by as much as 13% in Monday's session — continuing to shave off any post-IPO gains — as the Elon Musk company is already announcing its first bond issuance.
summary_zh: SpaceX (SPCX) 股价在周一交易中下跌了 13%，继续削减 IPO 后的涨幅，因为这家埃隆·马斯克公司已经宣布发行首次债券。
